className.description:
The Java class of the method called. This may be abbreviated in some renderings, for example
"j.l.NullPointerException" for "java.lang.NullPointerException".

methodName.description: The name of the method called in this stack frame.

fileName.description: The source file name of the method called.

lineNumber.description: The source file line number of the method at the point of the exception (or call to another method).

fileMetadataPath.description: If the frame can be identified with a particular scripting language file, the path to that source file.

source.description: Code snippet that threw the error, with line numbers.

title: This type represents a frame in a stacktrace. This could be from Java or from a scripting language.
name: StackFrame
